story: Holiday pie pre-orders for a neighborhood bakery
source_line: Sample reel for a fictional bakery

segments.label: HOLIDAY PIES
segments.title: Our pies sold out by noon last year
segments.narration: Last year our holiday pies sold out by noon. This year, you can skip the line.

segments.label: WHAT'S NEW
segments.title: Pre-orders are open now
segments.narration: Pre-orders are open now for apple, pecan and pumpkin, baked fresh the morning you pick up.

segments.label: HOW IT WORKS
segments.title: Order online, pick up warm
segments.narration: Order online, choose a pickup time, and walk past the line to grab your pie still warm.

segments.label: WHY PRE-ORDER
segments.title: Batches are small on purpose
segments.narration: Every pie is made by hand, so batches are small. Once a day is full, it's full.

segments.label: BAKER'S TIP
segments.title: Warm it ten minutes at 350°
segments.point: Tastes like it just came out
segments.narration: Baker's tip: warm it for ten minutes at three fifty. It tastes like it just came out.

segments.label: CRUMB & KETTLE
segments.title: Reserve your pie today
segments.narration: Reserve your pie today. The order link is in our bio.
